description.content:
Provides a graph from some stats of a Test Result.

Element statistics can be mixed with monitor statistics. Only limitation is around PERCENTILES_DURATION element statistic that cannot be mixed with other element statistics neither with monitor statistics.
The graph width is limited to 800 pixels and the graph height is limited to 400 pixels.
